en.name: Flower symbols
en.title: Flower Symbols: Copy and Paste Floral Text Art (✿ ❀ ❁)
en.description: Copy and paste 16 flower symbols, from the plain ✿ and ❀ to snowflakes ❄, a shamrock ☘ and emoji blossoms. Tap a tile to copy, then use it in a divider.
en.lede: Flowers, snowflakes and blossoms to copy. Most are plain text, so they match your font, and the last five are emoji with their own colors.

body.body: A short run such as ✿ ❀ ✿ makes a divider that works in a profile, a caption or a plain text email. Because the flowers are text, you can set one as a list bullet and keep the same color as the line. The five-petal ✿ and the eight-petal ✾ differ at small sizes, so test them in the app you will post in.

The snowflakes ❄ ❅ ❆ and the shamrock ☘ suit seasonal posts, from winter greetings to a March update. The emoji blossoms 🌸 🌼 🌻 🌷 🌹 are drawn by the phone in full color, which makes them the right pick for a greeting card and the wrong one for a text-only field.

faq: Which flower looks best as a line divider?
✿ and ❀ repeat well because they are similar in height. Put a space between them so that each flower stays clear on a narrow phone screen.
Why does ☘ look different on my laptop?
Each system font draws it in its own way, and some fonts have no shamrock at all. When it shows as a box, swap in ✿ or an emoji flower.

zh.name: 花朵符号
zh.title: 花朵符号：复制粘贴花朵文字图案（✿ ❀ ❁）
zh.description: 一键复制 16 个花朵符号，从简单的 ✿ 和 ❀ 到雪花 ❄、三叶草 ☘ 和表情花朵。点击方块即可复制，用在分隔线或昵称里。
zh.lede: 可以复制的花朵、雪花和花束符号。多数是普通文字，会和字体保持一致，最后五个是自带颜色的表情。

body.h2: 用花朵做分隔线和项目符号
body.body: 像 ✿ ❀ ✿ 这样的一小串，可以做成个人简介、配文或纯文本邮件里的分隔线。花朵是文字，所以也能当作列表的项目符号，并且和这一行保持同样的颜色。五瓣的 ✿ 和八瓣的 ✾ 在小字号下差别明显，发布前最好在实际使用的应用里试一下。

body.h2: 雪花、三叶草和表情花朵
body.body: 雪花 ❄ ❅ ❆ 和三叶草 ☘ 适合应季的内容，从冬日问候到三月的更新通知。表情花朵 🌸 🌼 🌻 🌷 🌹 由手机以全彩绘制，适合做贺卡，但不适合只能输入文字的输入框。

faq: 哪种花朵最适合做分隔线？
✿ 和 ❀ 高度相近，重复排列很整齐。中间加一个空格，在窄屏手机上每朵花也能看得清楚。
为什么 ☘ 在电脑上看起来不一样？
每种系统字体的画法都不同，有些字体根本没有三叶草。显示成方框时，换成 ✿ 或表情花朵就行。
